module.name: ibm_roks_bnk_flo
module.description: Deploy F5 BIG-IP Next for Kubernetes onto an existing IBM ROKS cluster using the upstream FLO module, IBM Cloud, and COS-backed artifacts.

required.name: ibmcloud_api_key
required.description: IBM Cloud API key used to access the target cluster and supporting IBM resources.

required.name: ibmcloud_cluster_region
required.description: IBM Cloud region where the existing ROKS cluster resides.

required.name: roks_cluster_name_or_id
required.description: Name or ID of the existing IBM ROKS cluster to install BNK onto.

optional.name: ibmcloud_resource_group
optional.description: IBM Cloud resource group used to discover the target cluster and COS resources.

optional.name: far_repo_url
optional.description: FAR repository URL used for BNK artifacts.

optional.name: f5_bigip_k8s_manifest_version
optional.description: Version of the f5-bigip-k8s-manifest chart used to resolve FLO and CIS artifacts.

optional.name: use_cos_bucket
optional.description: Whether FAR credentials and the JWT token should be fetched from IBM Cloud Object Storage.

optional.name: ibmcloud_cos_bucket_region
optional.description: IBM Cloud region where the COS bucket is located.

optional.name: ibmcloud_cos_instance_name
optional.description: IBM Cloud COS instance name containing the FAR and JWT files.

optional.name: ibmcloud_resources_cos_bucket
optional.description: COS bucket containing the FAR auth archive and subscription JWT.

optional.name: f5_cne_far_auth_file
optional.description: FAR auth key filename in the COS bucket.

optional.name: f5_cne_subscription_jwt_file
optional.description: Subscription JWT filename in the COS bucket.

optional.name: flo_utils_namespace
optional.description: Namespace for F5 utility components used by FLO.

optional.name: bigip_username
optional.description: Optional BIG-IP username for CIS controller login.

optional.name: bigip_password
optional.description: Optional BIG-IP password for CIS controller login.

optional.name: bigip_url
optional.description: Optional BIG-IP URL for CIS controller login.

key_outputs.name: target_cluster_name_or_id
key_outputs.description: Name or ID of the existing target cluster passed into the wrapper.

key_outputs.name: flo_release_name
key_outputs.description: Name of the FLO Helm release.

key_outputs.name: flo_utils_namespace
key_outputs.description: Namespace used for F5 utility components.

key_outputs.name: flo_extracted_flo_version
key_outputs.description: FLO version derived from the selected manifest version.

key_outputs.name: flo_pod_deployment_status
key_outputs.description: Deployment status details for FLO pods.

key_outputs.name: flo_trusted_profile_id
key_outputs.description: IBM IAM trusted profile ID created for the BNK controller.

key_outputs.name: flo_cluster_issuer_name
key_outputs.description: Cluster issuer name configured for FLO certificates.

required.name: ibmcloud_api_key
required.description: IBM Cloud credential template or project secret providing the API key.
